scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/app.js', fs.readFileSync('src/app.js')); console.log('Build erfolgreich: Artefakt erstellt.');"
scripts.smoke: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/app.js')) { console.log('Smoke Test: OK'); } else { console.error('Smoke Test: Failed'); process.exit(1); }"
